notes: BitesToken (src/BitesToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on the vendored OpenZeppelin v5.0.2 ERC20 base: name bites, symbol BIT, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 BIT (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, INITIAL_SUPPLY) once to msg.sender, which is the factory under launchCustom. There is no mint, burn, tax, fee, reflection, rebase, pause, blacklist, owner, role, proxy, upgrade path, external call or linked library; every transfer delivers exactly the amount requested, so the swarm share, the pool seed, the remainder and claims all move whole without any exemption list. The token exposes no privileged function and the deployer holds no power over any other balance. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 at the launch policy fee of 12500 (1.25%) with tick spacing 60; initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (2,500 IMD cap for the whole supply) and totalSupply. Economics are the requester's: 7000 bps of the supply seeds the pool and the remainder of the requester's share goes to 0xee2aaa315cf7ed169f93148d30d24af9318dbb66. The swarm's share is taken by the factory and is not written here.
